cartridges.setting: unconfirmed exact crack pressure — no numeric value printed on this element

cartridges.role: LS shuttle/orifice elements in the LS_A / LS_B lines (the <O> and X symbols along the dashed cyan lines)

flow_scenarios: DOWN command (<5V): PVEU pilot shifts main spool to A-side; P rail flow -> spool -> A work port -> through pilot-operated check stack -> actuator; return flow from B port -> spool -> T rail; LS_A line reports A-port pressure to LS rail

UP command (>5V): PVEU pilot shifts main spool to B-side; P rail flow -> spool -> B work port -> through pilot-operated check stack -> actuator; return flow from A port -> spool -> T rail; LS_B line reports B-port pressure to LS rail

Neutral (spool centered, open-center): P connects directly to T across the spool (open neutral), A and B ports blocked/held by the pilot-operated check (counterbalance) stack so the keel load is locked in position
Overpressure on A or B work line: respective relief (220 or 60 setting) opens, diverting excess flow from that work port directly to the T/tank return rail, independent of spool position
settings: 220 (unit not printed, presumed bar) relief on one work line
60 (unit not printed, presumed bar) relief on other work line

B: work port, routed via internal line 157B6203 to actuator connection at top (labeled B), also taps to LS_B and relief
LS_A / LS_B: load-sense lines at bottom rail, continue off-sheet

flow_scenarios: Neutral (de-energized): spool closed-center, no flow from P to A or B; work ports A and B blocked -> lifting keel locks held mechanically in place, no oil movement to actuator

Energized (ON): PVEO pilot shifts main spool, P connects to A (IN=A), return path from B to T (OUT=B) per printed IN=A/OUT=B label -> oil flows P->spool->A port to unlock/actuate keel lock, displaced oil from B returns to tank rail

LS sensing: pressure at A and/or B work ports is tapped through the two '100' orifices into the shuttle (circle-diamond) which passes the higher/selected signal onward to the LS_A / LS_B rail at bottom of sheet (continues off-crop to pump LS manifold)

flow_scenarios: Neutral (open-center): spool centered, P flow passes through open-center path directly to T return rail; no flow to A or B work ports; LS line unloaded (no load signal to LS rail).
Energized position 1° or 3° (=A): solenoid pilot shifts spool so P connects to A work port; B work port connects to T return; LS line picks up A port pressure signal via shuttle to LS_A.
Energized position 2° (=B): solenoid pilot shifts spool opposite direction so P connects to B work port; A work port connects to T return; LS line picks up B port pressure signal via shuttle to LS_B.
Overpressure on A work line: if pressure exceeds relief cartridge setting (250 bar, left cartridge), relief opens diverting A-line oil toward return/LS rail to limit pressure.
Overpressure on B work line: if pressure exceeds relief cartridge setting (225 bar, right cartridge), relief opens diverting B-line oil toward return/LS rail to limit pressure.

P (pressure) inlet: top of stack, red vertical line, off-sheet upward
T (return/tank): bottom rail, cyan/blue horizontal line, off-sheet both directions
LS_A and LS_B: bottom of crop, labeled ports feeding into LS rail, off-sheet downward/sideways

flow_scenarios: Neutral (de-energized): spool centered, open-center neutral position — pump flow passes through spool to tank/return rail, no flow to A or B, winch motor holds position via counterbalance/check in 157B7123 cartridge.
Energized position 1° or 3° (=A): pilot solenoid shifts spool so P->A port->winch motor inlet; B port becomes return path B->spool->tank; winch drives in one direction.
Energized position 2° (=B): spool shifts opposite, P->B port->winch motor; A port returns to tank; winch drives in reverse direction.

Overpressure on work line: if pressure at A or B work port exceeds relief setting (250 or 225, units unstated but presumed bar), the corresponding work-port relief cartridge opens and dumps excess flow to the tank/return rail, protecting the motor/circuit.

LS signalling: pressure at the active work port is sensed via the cyan LS line and communicated to the LS_B rail at the bottom of the crop for load-sense compensation elsewhere in the manifold (off-sheet).
